title: Application Scientist
description:
ABOUT CUSPAI

CuspAI is the frontier AI company on a mission to solve the breakthrough materials needed to power human progress. While nature took billions of years to perfect molecules, we are harnessing AI to unlock trillion-dollar materials breakthroughs in months, not millennia. Our founding team is the most cited in the world, comprised of world-class researchers in AI, chemistry and engineering.

We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock.

We invite you to be part of a diverse, innovative team at the intersection of AI and materials science, working to create impactful partnerships that drive innovation, scalability, and industry collaboration. This work matters. Your work matters.

We’re on the cusp of the on-demand materials era. Join us.

THE ROLE

We hire across a spectrum of backgrounds. Some Application Scientists are computational (atomistic and molecular simulation, machine-learned force fields), some are experimental (synthesis, processing, characterisation, lab automation), and some are data-driven (materials and cheminformatics, optimisation). What they share is the ability to turn a partner’s problem into a plan, deliver it, and translate fluently between experimental, computational, and machine learning teams.

We operate a matrix structure. You will have a home team, but may contribute to projects in another pillar as demand and your expertise evolve.

YOUR IMPACT

You will own the scientific delivery of partner projects, from scoping to results. Working with our technical programme managers, ML researchers, platform engineers, and lab integration team, you will make sure our platform answers the questions that matter to partners, and that what is learned on each project feeds back into tools and workflows used across the company.

Alongside delivery, you will help build the cross-cutting capabilities that future projects depend on, such as validated workflows, harmonised data pipelines and agentic design campaigns.

APPLICATION AREAS

We are particularly interested in candidates with expertise in one or more of the areas below. You do not need to cover a whole pillar.

- Electronics: Semiconductor processing, device-level modelling and electronics, photonic and thermal materials

- Energy: Catalysis, batteries, photovoltaics and multiscale kinetics.

- Environment: Porous and soft materials, interfaces, and separations

- Cross-cutting: Materials informatics, automated experimentation and optimisation.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

PROJECT LEADERSHIP AND DELIVERY

- Lead partner projects from scoping to delivery, as a key point of contact alongside the technical program managers.

- Write technical scopes that define objectives, deliverables, success criteria, and timelines.

- Prepare regular technical reports and presentations for partners and internal teams.

SCIENCE AND CAMPAIGNS

- Apply and extend our platform to partner problems, using simulation, machine learning, data-driven optimisation, or experiments as the project requires.

- Design and steer discovery campaigns, including agentic and closed-loop campaigns with partner labs.

- Assess when models, simulations, and data can be trusted, and contribute to validating them against experiments.

BRIDGING EXPERIMENTAL AND COMPUTATIONAL TEAMS

- Translate platform recommendations into clear, executable experimental plans, and translate lab realities back into requirements for internal teams.

- Make sure data from partners and our own workflows are clean, structured, and consistent.

- Work closely with partner labs, including on-site visits at key stages of a project.

CAPABILITY AND PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT

- Build and automate workflows that run reliably at scale within our platform.

title: Designer, Brand and Growth
description:
Salary range: $90K to $110K, plus equity
About Badge

Mobile wallets now account for roughly as many in-store purchases as cash, and unlike cash, they're still climbing. Most brands still treat them as a place to store a card.

Badge is the infrastructure that changes that. We give enterprise brands and platforms one integration to issue and operate passes and cards across Apple, Google, and Samsung Wallet. Loyalty cards, stored value, memberships, IDs, and tickets, all living on the surface customers already carry, updating in real time, with no app download and no new account.
The platform meets teams wherever they work: a no-code UI for marketers, flexible APIs for developers, an embed SDK for platform partners, and an MCP server so AI agents can build on it directly. That powers in-wallet push notifications, location-based messages, offers, tap-to-redeem, and more.
We are a fast-growing team backed by leading investors including TTV Capital, Stripe, Synchrony Ventures, and Infinity Ventures, and trusted by companies like Hoka, Blackhawk Network, Shift4, and Yale University. We value sharp thinking, fast execution, and a real understanding of how customers behave in a mobile-first world.

Position overview
Join Badge as a Brand and Growth Designer to shape how the world sees and experiences Badge . You'll own design for our growth marketing, including the website, content, social, email, and sales materials. You'll also work closely with product to deepen knowledge and accuracy across the Badge product suite.
This role is a great fit for a versatile designer who loves ownership, moves quickly between brand and sales enablement, and gets energized when their work drives pipeline, closes deals, and helps customers succeed.
Questions we're exploring
* How do we make mobile wallets feel like an obvious, must-have channel to enterprise marketers who haven't thought about them before?
* How do we speak to three different audiences (marketers, developers, and platform partners) without our story fragmenting?
* How do we show wallet experiences like push notifications, location-based offers, and tap-to-redeem in ways that are visual and easy to understand?
* How do we give sales and marketing a template system they can use on their own while keeping the brand consistent?
* How can the marketing site and the product feel like one connected experience, from first visit to first pass created?
Core Responsibilities

• Orchestrate the Badge website. Design, build, and iterate on trybadge.com in Webflow in collaboration with agencies and leadership as needed. Website design includes landing pages, product and solution pages, and campaign/event pages. Work with marketing to test and improve what converts.

• Enable sales and leadership. Build and refine sales decks, one-pagers, customer case studies, and executive and investor presentations, and maintain a template library the team can use on their own.

• Power content and social. Create blog visuals, product diagrams, and LinkedIn assets (posts, carousels, event and launch graphics) that make wallet experiences easy to understand.

• Bring Badge to life at events. Design conference and event collateral, booth graphics, signage, and swag that make Badge stand out in person.

• Build email that scales. Design reusable email templates for newsletters, product updates, and nurture campaigns.

• Build systems, not one-offs. Maintain and evolve Badge 's visual identity across every touchpoint, and contribute to our design system, brand guidelines, and scalable templates, so every new asset is faster to make and stays consistent.

• Design with AI. Use tools like Claude, Figma AI, and other emerging tools to explore concepts, speed up production, and prototype. AI helps you move faster; your judgment and craft decide what ships.

• Collaborate across the team. Work with marketing, sales, product, and engineering to understand goals, give and get feedback, and ship work that moves the business.

title: Privacy Specialist
description:
Description
WHO WE ARE
Come join the company at the center of how the world adopts AI securely. Cyera ’s mission is to give enterprises the confidence to embrace AI safely - deciding exactly what it can see and do as it reaches deeper into the business. We started by solving the hardest problem in data security: finding and securing data faster and more precisely than anyone thought possible. That foundation is now the essential AI trust infrastructure for the Fortune 1000. We’re hiring mission-driven talent to put those leaders at the center of our story.
THE OPPORTUNITY
Cyera is seeking a Privacy Specialist to help us win and expand our privacy line of business. This is a technical, customer-facing go-to-market role that supports our sales organization. You will be the privacy expert in the room alongside our Account Executives and Sales Engineers, turning a prospect's privacy requirements into compelling, credible demonstrations, proofs of value, and RFP responses that help our sellers move deals forward. You will work in front of prospects and customers across the full suite of privacy capabilities, including data subject requests, data mapping, privacy assessments, risk management, and consent and preference management.
To be clear about what this is: a technical, external-facing role that supports our sales team, not an in-house privacy or compliance role. Your privacy expertise matters because it helps our sellers win. You will be equally comfortable presenting to executive privacy leaders and to hands-on technologists and operators, building tailored demos, and writing RFP responses that stand out. You will be a key player in how Cyera sells privacy, and your insight from the field will shape the product. We're an AI-forward team, and the strongest candidates will show us how they use AI to work smarter and how they'd help customers navigate the intersection of AI, privacy, and data security.
RESPONSIBILITIES:
Field Engagement

• Serve as the privacy subject matter expert for sales and solutions teams, joining discovery calls, demos, and executive briefings with prospects and customers.

• Build and deliver tailored demos that connect Cyera 's privacy capabilities to each customer's regulatory drivers, operating model, and existing use cases.

• Lead proof of value engagements from scoping through customer readout, including success criteria, tenant and environment setup with the account team, and aligning product capabilities to customer use cases.

• Own privacy responses to RFPs, RFIs, and related questionnaires, delivering accurate, consistent, and timely answers and coordinating input from internal teams.

• Coach go-to-market (GTM) teams on privacy discovery and qualification, and help them pursue privacy opportunities across prospects and existing accounts.

Pre-Sales Support

• Run the privacy demo request process, including intake, prep documentation, agendas, and engaging the right SMEs for each call.

• Provide privacy-specific input to sellers and Revenue Operations so privacy opportunities are accurately scoped and recorded in our CRM.

• Serve as the day-to-day point of contact on active pursuits, POVs, and RFPs.

• Hand off cleanly to Customer Success and Implementation teams so customers move smoothly from sale to deployment.

Product and Technical Expertise

• Act as a power user of the privacy products, with working knowledge of its modules, integrations, and configuration, so you can demo and troubleshoot with confidence.

• Capture structured customer feedback, feature gaps, and win and loss insights, and relay them to the Product team to influence the roadmap.

GTM Enablement

• Develop demo scripts, talk tracks, and recorded walkthroughs across the full suite of privacy capabilities.

• Enable and certify technical teams to present privacy modules with confidence.

• Work with Product Marketing to turn field learnings into positioning, collateral, and customer stories.

Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

 

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

 

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

Design and build the machines, fixtures, and tooling used to manufacture HTS magnet coils.

Work hands-on with technicians to build, debug, and commission equipment on the shop floor.

Select and manage external vendors and machine shops for components, subassemblies, and fabricated parts.

title: Technical Product Marketing Manager
description:
ABOUT BASETEN

Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma, and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F https://www.baseten.co/blog/announcing-our-series-f/, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to ship AI products.

THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Technical Product Marketing Manager who can pick up any Baseten product and explain it clearly to the people who buy it. Baseten sells dedicated inference, Model APIs, training and post-training, and the enterprise platform that ties them together. The work behind each one is the same: understand how the product works, know where it stands against the alternatives, and write about it well enough that an ML engineer trusts it and a buyer acts on it.

We’re hiring for this role across multiple product lines. You’ll work on whichever launch, narrative, or competitive gap matters most at the time, partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, and the rest of product marketing. It’s a good fit for someone who ramps on technical products quickly and wants to be the person who figures out the story.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Positioning & Technical Narrative

- Own positioning and messaging for Baseten products across inference, Model APIs, training and post-training, and the core platform, written for ML engineers, platform teams, and executive buyers.

- Work closely with Product and Engineering to understand architecture, tradeoffs, and roadmap, and make sure every technical claim is accurate and backed by how the product actually behaves.

- Keep product-level messaging consistent with Baseten’s platform narrative so each product story supports the others.

- Write messaging that is technically credible without getting lost in implementation detail.

Launches & Go-to-Market

- Build and run launch plans for new products and major capabilities, from internal enablement through external announcement.

- Decide what deserves a full launch and what should ship through docs, sales enablement, or targeted customer outreach.

- Create launch assets including messaging briefs, landing pages, technical blog posts, demo storylines, sales decks, one-pagers, and FAQs.

- Partner with Demand Gen, Sales, Solutions, and Customer Marketing to turn product capabilities into campaigns and deal support.

Competitive & Market Insight

- Track the competitive landscape across inference providers, model API companies, hyperscalers, and internal DIY platforms, including pricing, packaging, launches, and messaging.

- Turn that analysis into a clear point of view on where Baseten wins and loses, and use it to sharpen positioning.

- Talk to customers and sellers to understand buying criteria, objections, and deal blockers, and bring what you learn back to Product and Marketing as concrete recommendations.

Sales Enablement

- Build battlecards, competitive talk tracks, objection-handling guides, and product training that sellers actually use.

- Work with Sales and Solutions to find enablement gaps and close them.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

- 4+ years in product marketing, technical marketing, or developer marketing, with at least 2 of those years marketing to developers or technical buyers at an infrastructure, developer tools, cloud, data, or AI company.

- Strong writing. You can take a dense technical topic and make it clear without oversimplifying it, and you have samples to show.

- Technical fluency. You’re comfortable reading docs, asking engineers specific questions, and getting up to speed on concepts like inference, autoscaling, fine-tuning, and open- vs. closed-weight models.

- Hands-on competitive analysis experienc

title: Operations Manager- Member Experience
description:
Position summary
The Operations Manager, Member Experience supports the overall operations of VIVIO's Member Experience organization and issue resolution and quality. In this client-facing role, the manager works directly with clients, consultants and vendors on member-facing issues, owning each from first notice to final resolution:
We are looking for a strong root cause analyst who looks past individual complaints to find and fix the underlying process, system, policy or training gap. Member issue resolution, quality and AI tool oversight are the core focus, but the role supports Member Experience operations wherever the business needs it as VIVIO grows.
Key responsibilities
Client, Consultant and Vendor Partnership

• Serve as a primary point of contact for clients, consultants and vendors on member-facing issues, owning communication from intake to resolution with clear, proactive updates.

• Lead issue review calls and deliver written resolution summaries covering timeline, member impact, root cause, corrective actions and follow-up commitments.

• Handle difficult conversations with composure and empathy, balancing partner expectations with contract terms, regulatory requirements and operational realities.

• Build trusted relationships and present issue trends, quality results and improvements in client and consultant business reviews.

Member Issue Resolution and Escalations

• Prioritize member-facing issues by urgency and impact to minimize medication delays, and serve as the final internal escalation point for complex member, pharmacy, prescriber and payer issues.

• Coordinate with providers, pharmacies, vendors and internal teams to resolve cases and confirm the member outcome before closure.

• Maintain intake, triage, SLA and documentation standards, and streamline workflows that delay medication fills or other member services.

• Track KPIs (volume, time to resolution, SLA adherence, repeat issues, satisfaction) and audit case handling to drive improvement plans.

Root Cause Analysis and Continuous Improvement

• Lead structured root cause analysis on issues, escalations, complaints, quality failures and incidents using methods such as 5 Whys, fishbone diagrams, Pareto analysis and process mapping.

• Separate symptoms from underlying causes (process, system, data, policy, vendor or training) and validate findings with data.

• Own corrective and preventive action (CAPA) plans with clear owners, deadlines and success measures, and confirm fixes are sustained.

• Analyze trends to catch recurring failure points and emerging risks early, and partner with cross-functional teams to fix problems at the source.

Quality and Compliance

• Lead the quality program, including call and case audits, scorecards, evaluator calibration and timely, constructive feedback.

• Ensure adherence to policies, client and payer contracts, HIPAA and healthcare regulations; support internal, external and client audits.

• Turn quality findings into root cause inputs, training recommendations, job aids and updated SOPs.

AI Tool Oversight

• Serve as the team's expert on VIVIO's AI tool and coach staff on using it well.

• Review AI-assisted interactions for accuracy and compliance, partner with technology to improve the tool, and identify automation opportunities that reduce repeat issues and strengthen quality.

Leadership, Reporting and Collaboration

• Coach and develop team leads and staff; manage schedules, goals and performance reviews, and build a culture of ownership and member-first service.

• Report issue, escalation, quality and root cause trends to leadership with data-driven insights and progress on corrective actions.

Required

• 3+ years in member experience, PBM, pharmacy claims or related healthcare operations.

• 2+ years managing teams in a queue-based or contact center environment, including escalations or quality assurance.

• Client-facing experience resolving member-facing issues directly with clients, consulta

As a Manager/Senior Manager, you will lead project teams delivering market analysis, price forecasts, asset valuations, transaction support, and strategic advisory services to a diverse client base including independent power producers, developers, utilities, infrastructure investors, private equity firms, lenders, data center developers, and government agencies. Project Leadership and Client Delivery

• Represent ICF at industry conferences, client meetings, webinars, and other external forums.

• Publish white papers, market insights, presentations, and other thought leadership content.

• Contribute to enhancement of ICF 's proprietary market forecasting models, databases, and analytical capabilities.

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

title: Learning Design & Enablement Partner

At TrendAI™, we’re always seeking exceptional talent; people who want to collaborate with the best and push boundaries together. Here, your work goes beyond building a career. You will help protect what matters and play a vital role in shaping a safer, more trustworthy AI-powered future.
AI Fearlessly.
Position Summary:

TrendAI is moving fast, and our leaders and teams need to change how they work just as fast. Good intent is not enough: culture, leadership and execution habits only change when learning is designed for behavior change, not for a good feeling on the day. There is limited L&D support at TrendAI today, so this role brings that expertise into HR for the first time. Impact means growth: every program should help leaders and teams execute faster and drive high ARR growth, so you will prioritize ruthlessly for business impact.

You'll partner with our HR Global Partners to design and deliver workshops and programs that roll out culture, help leadership teams turn ideas into execution plans, and turn intent into behaviors that stick. You'll bring an outside-in view of what works, propose before you are asked, and challenge requests when there is a better answer. You'll also bring the same discipline to HR's own change: how we launch programs and systems, how employees find answers, and how our HR team builds its skills.

What You'll Do :

You'll build a modular library of ready-to-run workshops on culture, leading through change, manager essentials, feedback and team effectiveness, each packaged with a facilitator guide, materials and a reinforcement plan so HR Global Partners can deliver it to standard in every region. Every program you design starts from the behavior and business outcome it should move, uses the right format for the job, and builds in practice, manager follow-up and AI coaching so learning survives the first week back.

You'll also raise the capability of HR itself through train-the-trainer, coaching and a skills curriculum covering facilitation, consulting, change, Workday, data and AI fluency, and advise other functions on build, buy or curate decisions when the work sits outside HR. For HR's own launches, you'll create a standard launch kit, design the HR knowledge base and the content behind our AI assistant, and build a network of change champions across regions.

• Design and personally facilitate workshops, leadership team offsites and bootcamps for leaders, managers and teams across functions.

• Build and run leadership and manager development programs, such as new manager journeys and leading through change.

• Translate culture and values into observable behaviors, team rituals and manager routines.

• Use AI and digital tools to design faster and personalize learning, with a clear view of where human contact matters most.

• Measure impact and stickiness, and report what works, what to change and what to stop.

• Prioritize for impact: put your time where it accelerates execution and ARR growth, and redirect, scale through others or say no to the rest.

• Lead change management for HR programs and systems, and partner with HR technology on Workday, knowledge and case management tools.

• Step in as a specialized HR generalist on complex questions during launches, and turn recurring themes into content, training or a process fix.

What You Should Have:

• 7+ years in learning design, leadership development or organizational development, with substantial experience both designing and delivering.

• A portfolio of programs you designed and delivered, with evidence of behavior or business impact, ideally in a high-grow

title: Product Manager
description:
The brands on your kitchen shelf are run by people doing extraordinary work that nobody sees.

We're building the platform they run on, and a brand they'll be proud to be part of.

Confido is the AI operating system that runs cash application, deductions, trade and planning in one place for CPG brands. That means Finance, Sales, and Ops finally work on the same number.

We’re trusted by 250+ brands managing $30B+ in revenue, including Daisy, OLIPOP, Simple Mills, Idahoan, and more. We've achieved best-in-class growth and recently raised a $55M Series B led by Insight Partners to accelerate our momentum.

If you want your work on shelves everywhere - and outsized ownership while you build - we'd love to meet you.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Product Manager, you'll own meaningful surface area across a complex, interconnected product, from figuring out what to build to making sure it lands with customers. You’ll work with engineers, designers, and CPG experts across the company, as well as GTM teams, to scale the business, and build features that benefit brands selling billions of dollars worth of products.

Until now, product has been diffused across the team. We were able to move very quickly while maintaining high context across both customers and our internal team. That said, product scope has increased quickly. We now sell an accounting automation platform, trade promotion management tool, sales forecasting tool and analytics platform; each one of these surface areas go deep and have single companies built around them. You will start supporting the breadth of the platform, taking on deeper ownership of an end-to-end business line as we scale.

What You’ll Own

- The success of your product area. The product direction, the quality of what ships, and the revenue and customer outcomes that drive it.

- The roadmap and vision. Define a roadmap for the next sprint, quarter and year of your product area.

- The go-to-market narrative. Define the value drivers and differentiation for your area relative to the competitive landscape, enable the sales team, and be ready to step in and own the narrative on customer calls.

- Clarity end to end. Make sure the product is well-documented - how it works, how to demo it, how customers get onboarded - and be able to say exactly where every major customer is in onboarding and what's blocking them.

- Whatever the product needs. Talk to customers every day, and pick up slack wherever it helps - taking a customer call, reproducing a reported bug, whatever moves things forward.

What We’re Looking For

- 3+ years of PM experience at high growth tech company or founding experience

- Comfort with ambiguity and a track record of taking things from 0 to 1

- Excellent verbal and written communication

- Owner mentality-drive the team to succeed

- AI fluency (prototyping, agentic workflows, LLM fundamentals, etc.)

🌴 PERKS + BENEFITS

- Equity - own a meaningful piece of the company you’re helping build

- Fully paid health coverage through Aetna - we cover 100% of employee premiums

- Top-tier dental and vision coverage through Guardian

- Carrot Fertility Pro - comprehensive fertility and family-forming support

title: Claims Verification Supervisor
description:
Our Story

TopDog Law is not your typical law firm. We're a nationally scaling personal injury firm built for impact and growth - owning the client experience end-to-end, from marketing and intake through litigation. We believe that world-class marketing, paired with exceptional legal talent and operations, creates better experiences and outcomes for clients and the business alike.

Over the past three years, we've grown 2-3x year over year, setting a new standard on the marketing side of the personal injury space and proving what's possible when strategy, speed, and execution align. Now we're applying that same discipline and innovation to firm operations, case management, and national scale - intentionally building the infrastructure, systems, and teams to grow without sacrificing quality, culture, or accountability.

We are a fully remote team that share trust, open communication, and a commitment to doing great work. If you love ownership, thrive in a fast-moving environment, and want to help build something exceptional, you'll feel right at home here.

The Opportunity

The Claims Verification Supervisor oversees daily operations of the claims verification team, ensuring accurate and timely review of claims in accordance with company policies and regulatory requirements. This is a high-ownership role focused on team performance, quality control, and process improvement - measured by accuracy rates, turnaround times, and denial reduction.

What You Will Own

Team Leadership

• Supervise, coach, and evaluate claims verification specialists

• Manage workload distribution to meet turnaround time (TAT) standards

• Lead onboarding and ongoing training on claims procedures and compliance

Claims Oversight & Quality

• Audit completed claims to identify errors and training opportunities

• Serve as escalation point for complex or high-value claims

• Enforce verification standards and internal controls to minimize fraud, waste, and abuse

Reporting & Process Improvement

• Track KPIs including accuracy rates, TAT, denial rates, and productivity

• Identify workflow inefficiencies and implement improvements

• Report team performance and claim outcomes to senior management

Compliance & Collaboration

• Ensure documentation accuracy and compliance with all regulatory requirements

• Stay current on payer rule changes and industry best practices

• Partner cross-functionally with billing, underwriting, compliance, and legal teams

What You Bring

Required:

• 3-5 years of claims processing or verification experience

• 1-2 years of supervisory or lead experience in a claims or operations environment

• Strong understanding of claims adjudication, documentation standards, and regulatory compliance

• Proficiency in claims management systems and Microsoft Office Suite

• Analytical mindset with the ability to translate data into actionable decisions

• Clear communicator; able to present findings and recommendations to stakeholders

• Bachelor’s degree in a related field preferred; equivalent experience considered

Who Thrives Here (Core Values)

We don't hire on resumes alone. We hire for competence, character, and mindset.

•
Embrace Change: Open to feedback, embracing change, and always asking "what's next?"

•
Committed: You care deeply, have your teammates' backs, and show up to build something lasting.

•
No-Ego Energy: Positive, professional, and solutions-oriented. Drama stays at the door.

•
Ownership: You do what you say, follow through, and treat the business like it's yours.

•
Fast & Hungry: You move with urgency, thrive under high expectations, and are motivated by growth and impact.

What We Offer

title: Product Manager, Sail Core
description:
Who we are
About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies-from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups-use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.
About the team
Sail Core builds Stripe 's frontend platform-the data layer, navigation, observability, and developer tooling that 50+ product teams use to ship web applications, with the Dashboard being the largest. We are responsible for enabling a stellar developer experience for frontend engineers at Stripe . We're hiring a deeply technical product manager to own the platform strategy, drive cross-company modernization initiatives, and set the standard for frontend excellence at Stripe .
What you'll do
How should a platform team decide what to build when 50 teams depend on you and each one thinks their request is the most urgent? When do you invest in long-term architectural health versus shipping the migration that unblocks next quarter's goal? How do you make 9,000 files at initialization become a fast, traceable, joyful developer experience-without breaking production for millions of merchants along the way?
Responsibilities

• Own the product strategy and roadmap for Stripe 's frontend platform

• Drive the largest frontend modernization initiative at Stripe while holding the line on architectural quality

• Redefine frontend development with agentic tooling

• Define and track key metrics such as latency, build times, and reliability SLOs to make difficult trade-off decisions

• Be the product voice in deeply technical decisions such as API surface design, framework deprecation sequencing, extraction boundaries, and migration tooling

Who you are
You think in systems, not features. You go deep on architecture, you don't delegate to engineering. You're the person who reads the RFC before the meeting, asks why the error response looks like that, and frames migrations in terms of user outcomes, not just engineering milestones. You treat developer experience as part of the product, not a byproduct.
We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
Minimum requirements

• 7+ years of product management experience, with at least 2 years on platform, infrastructure, or developer tools teams

• Strong technical fluency in frontend web development-you discuss JavaScript and TypeScript, React component models, build systems, and performance optimization with depth

• Experience driving large-scale migrations or platform transitions across multiple teams, including the sequencing, dependency management, and stakeholder alignment that make them succeed

• Demonstrated use of quantitative metrics to drive platform investment decisions-you've defined the metrics, not just tracked them

• Track record of partnering with engineering to make architectural trade-offs grounded in user impact

Preferred qualifications

• Engineering background-you've written frontend code professionally and it still shapes how you think about product decisions

• Led or significantly contributed to a legacy extraction or monolith decomposition effort and understand viscerally why they're hard and where they get stuck

Duties and Responsibilities:

The Optical Engineer for Semicon Metrology and Inspection is a highly skilled and market-focused professional. The ideal candidate will possess a strong engineering background in optical design, combined with a keen understanding of customer needs and requirements within the semiconductor metrology and inspection market. This role requires a thought leader who can partner with our customers on their most significant and complex challenges and, in turn, propose effective solutions. These solutions will require optical design and tolerance analysis using Zemax OpticStudio or similar software to meet customer specifications while maintaining manufacturability. This role will develop and lead solutions from concept to prototype through collaboration with internal and external key stakeholders, gaining alignment on specifications, testing protocols, and manufacturing methods throughout the process.

• Strong understanding of optical design principles, geometrical optics and aberration theory, and optical metrology techniques and methods.

• Ability to model and optimize 3D optical systems.

• Good understanding of integrated optical systems involving the integration of light sources, imaging optics, precision mechanics, image processing, and other key sub-systems and technologies.

• Ability to generate optical components specifications and drawings based on higher-level specifications and models.

• Ability to generate lens requirements, coating requirements, and optical system requirements from customer interactions and documents.

• Design feasibility experiments for opto-mechanical sub-systems, at times using simulation tools in support of R&D prototypes and production processes.

• Represent the company at industry events, conferences, and trade shows.

• Work with cross-functional teams, including product managers, engineers, supply chain, and QA, to align the right solution for a customer and/or a market.

• Identify baseline product and solution value for the market, competitors, and key suppliers who can support IDEX.

Requirements & Experience:

• A Bachelor of Science degree in an optics-related Engineering discipline and 2 years of relevant experience, OR a Master’s degree in a directly related field with 2 years of relevant experience.

• 2+ years experience

title: Events Manager
description:
As the Events Manager, you make every Quorum event run well-executed, on budget, and fully staffed. You own execution for our corporate and customer-facing events: trade shows, sponsored conferences, booths, VIP receptions, and customer events. Your work runs from the signed contract to the last lead in Salesforce.
You report to the Senior Manager of Events and Engagement, who sets the event calendar and strategy. You turn that plan into events that run without surprises. You work every day with Sales, the BDR team, Marketing Operations, and the Quorum executives who represent us onsite. The role comes with direct exposure to executives and a path for growth within the Events and Engagement team.
WHAT YOU'LL OWN
You own four things above all: logistics, budgets, staffing, and pre-event briefings.

• Event logistics: Run each event from contract signing through teardown, including venues, booth builds, AV, catering, travel, hotels, registration, and shipping. Build the timeline and run-of-show, and confirm every item ships or arrives on time.

• Event budgets: Build and track the budget for each event, from first quote to final invoice. Keep each event within its approved budget, flag overruns before they happen, and close out the books within 30 days.

• Event staffing: Build the staffing plan for each event, including who attends from Sales, the BDR team, executives, and Product, and what each person does on-site.

• Pre-event briefings: Own keeping everyone in the loop about the event goals and logistics. Cover the target accounts and customers attending, meetings booked, booth roles and shifts, talking points, and lead capture. Coach the team on how to be successful on site and how to follow up post-event.

• Venues, vendors, and contracts: Source venues and negotiate contracts within the approved budget. Manage venues, agencies, contractors, and third-party organizers on a day-to-day basis. Confirm Quorum receives every sponsorship deliverable it paid for, from booth space to attendee lists.

• Events as campaigns: Treat each event as one part of a campaign, not a one-off. Work with Marketing Operations and the BDR team so that pre-event outreach and post-event follow-up reach the same target accounts.

• Lead follow-up: Work with the marketing operations team for routing and follow-up to drive pipeline development.

• Post-event reporting: Report attendance, leads, pipeline, and ROI for each event. Run a retro with the team and write down what changes next time.

• Event playbooks: Build a repeatable playbook for each event type, with checklists, timelines, vendor lists, and brief templates. Each event run should be better coordinated than the last.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

• High-quality bar: Hold every detail to a high standard, from the booth and signage to the guest list and the follow-up email. Attendees should remember a Quorum event for the right reasons.

• Interpersonal skills and proactive communication: Build strong working relationships with Sales, BDRs, executives, vendors, and venue staff. Speak up early: flag risks, send updates before anyone asks, and follow up until every open item is closed. When something needs doing, you do it without waiting to be told.

• Audience & account-driven: Know which target accounts and customers will be at each event, and make sure the right Quorum people meet them.

• AI user, with judgment: Use AI to speed up event busywork, from invite lists to follow-up drafts, and check everything it produces before it goes out.

• Sets & hits goals: Own the operating goals for every event: on budget, staffed on time, briefs sent, and leads loaded fast. Use each event's results to decide which vendors, line items, and processes to keep, cut, or scale.

• Team orchestrator: Know what to handle yourself, what to hand to vendors, contractors, or AI, and who to keep updated. Drive coordination across Sales, BDRs, executives, product, and Marketing Operations without waiting to be asked.

title: Senior Manager, Global Direct Procurement
locationText: Amsterdam, North Holland, Netherlands; Berlin +10 more
description:
The role

HelloFresh manages approximately €1.7B in annual direct procurement spend across ingredients and packaging, covering markets in the EU, US, Canada, ANZ, and the UK. This role builds the cost intelligence capability for Global Procurement. You will create the analytical models and frameworks that give the business clear visibility into what ingredients really cost: where those costs come from, how they move, and where the opportunities lie. Your work will give regional teams the insight they need to make well-grounded decisions and to track progress against the group's cost reduction ambitions. This is a role for a senior procurement professional who is comfortable with detailed analysis and who can explain complex numbers simply to senior leaders and to colleagues in markets. You will be recognized as the go-to expert on cost across the team.

What you’ll do

• Develop a harmonized cost measurement methodology with Finance and regional procurement teams, so that ingredient savings are defined, measured, and reported consistently across all markets.

• Build should-cost models and total cost of ownership frameworks for priority categories, breaking unit price into its drivers (origin, processing method, logistics, certification, and shelf life), and use them to identify savings and inform sourcing decisions.

• Track ingredient price drivers across markets, including contract prices, actual prices, and market inflation, and identify overlap across brands to find rationalization and consolidation opportunities.

• Report progress against the group's ingredient cost reduction target to senior leadership, explaining root causes rather than just variances, and help build the governance needed to sustain this over time.

 

You are...

• An analytical professional who builds models that hold up to scrutiny from Finance and senior leadership.

• Commercially minded: you look at total value, not just unit price, and you understand what drives cost in food and packaging.

• A clear communicator who turns complex analysis into a simple story that regional teams can act on.

• Collaborative: you build alignment with Finance, procurement, and market teams through influence rather than authority.

• Self-directed: you manage several analyses at once and take ownership from the question through to the recommendation.

 

You have...

• 5+ years in procurement, cost analysis, or consulting in a global food, retail, or consumer goods business.

• Hands-on experience building should-cost models or total cost of ownership frameworks, and using them to influence real commercial decisions.

• Experience measuring cost and savings across multiple markets, including the common pitfalls such as inconsistent methods, inflation effects, and volume mix.

• Experience with food, ingredient, or packaging categories, including origin, certification, and specification considerations.

• Fluent in English. Bonus if fluent in French, German, or Dutch. Comfortable working across time zones, with the ability to travel up to 20%.

 

Nice to have...

• Familiarity with sustainability certification schemes and their cost implications.

• Experience with commodity price risk or hedging frameworks.

title: Data Engineer / Analytics Engineer confirmé — BigQuery & dbt

Contexte :
Dans le cadre d’un projet de décommissionnement de SAP BW, une organisation renforce son équipe Data Platform pour concevoir, industrialiser et optimiser ses pipelines de données sur Google Cloud.
Les données sources sont déposées sous forme brute dans BigQuery via SAP Datasphere. La mission porte principalement sur leur transformation en modèles analytiques fiables, performants et exploitables pour les usages décisionnels.
Livrables attendus :

• Pipelines de transformation développés avec dbt dans BigQuery.

• Modèles analytiques structurés et documentés.

• Tests de qualité intégrés aux traitements.

• Développements versionnés et intégrés au processus CI/CD.

• Documentation technique et d’exploitation.

Missions principales :

• Concevoir et développer les transformations de données sous BigQuery à l’aide de dbt.

• Structurer les modèles selon une architecture en couches de type médaillon : données brutes, données nettoyées et harmonisées, puis modèles analytiques.

• Traduire les règles de gestion définies avec les interlocuteurs métier et techniques en transformations SQL.

• Optimiser les performances et les coûts des traitements BigQuery, notamment par le partitionnement, le clustering et les stratégies de chargement adaptées.

• Mettre en place des tests et des contrôles de qualité des données.

• Industrialiser les développements en appliquant les bonnes pratiques de versionnement, de revue de code et d’intégration et de déploiement continus.

• Contribuer à la fiabilité des pipelines et à l’analyse des anomalies.

• Documenter les modèles de données, les transformations et les procédures d’exploitation.

• Selon les besoins, contribuer à l’exposition des données dans Looker à l’aide de LookML.

Expertise souhaitée
Profil recherché :
Vous disposez d’une expérience significative en Data Engineering ou Analytics Engineering et savez intervenir de manière autonome au sein d’une équipe Data Platform.
Vous faites preuve de rigueur dans la conception, les tests et la documentation. Vous êtes capable de comprendre les besoins métier, de clarifier les règles de transformation et de collaborer avec les équipes techniques et fonctionnelles.
Compétences requises :

• Maîtrise du SQL avancé et de la modélisation analytique.

• Expérience confirmée de BigQuery : développement, optimisation des requêtes, partitionnement et clustering.

• Expérience confirmée de dbt : modèles, dépendances, tests et documentation.

• Maîtrise de Git et des pratiques CI/CD appliquées à la data.

• Capacité à concevoir des traitements maintenables et fiables en production.

Compétences appréciées :

• Premières connaissances de Looker / LookML.

• Expérience de projets de migration d’entrepôts de données ou de refonte décisionnelle.

Jerry .ai is a Series C, YC-backed tech startup with 5M+ customers and $240M in funding. We're building the first AI-powered advisor to manage all your physical assets. title: Staff AV Behavior Safety Engineering Lead
description:
Job Description
At General Motors , our product teams are redefining mobility. Through a human-centered design process, we create vehicles and experiences that are designed not just to be seen, but to be felt. We’re turning today’s impossible into tomorrow’s standard -from breakthrough hardware and battery systems to intuitive design, intelligent software, and next-generation safety and entertainment features.
Every day, our products move millions of people as we aim to make driving safer, smarter, and more connected, shaping the future of transportation on a global scale.
The Safety Assurance for Effective Autonomous Driving Software (SAFE‑ADS) department is part of GM’s Global Product Safety, System, and Certification (GPSSC) organization. Our mission is to help GM deliver trusted automated‑driving products. As the central authority for automated driving system (ADS) safety, SAFE‑ADS brings together experts from across the company to develop and maintain a comprehensive safety case including safety performance indicators for GM’s automated‑driving technologies.
GM’s vision is zero crashes, zero emissions, and zero congestion-and autonomous vehicle safety is essential to achieving that vision.
As Staff AV Behavior and AI Safety Engineer , you will lead the strategy and support execution for how GM defines, measures, and validates the safety of SAE Level 3 - 4 Automated Driving Systems powered by machine‑learned models. You will report into the AV Safety Strategy and Assurance organization and directly influence launch decisions for GM’s next generation of automated driving products.
If you are passionate about safety, have deep experience in autonomous vehicle development and validation, and are a proven technical leader in AI/ML‑driven systems, this role is an opportunity to shape how millions of people experience safe automated driving.
The Role
The AV Safety Strategy and Assurance team is seeking a hands‑on Principal engineer with extensive experience in the end‑to‑end development lifecycle of autonomous vehicle behaviors, from ADS Architecture, ODD and behavior definition through simulation, closed‑course, and public‑road validation.
If you’re excited to lead in autonomous driving safety, we’d love to hear from you!
Why This Role Is Unique:

• Impact at Scale: Your work will directly influence how GM brings safe automated driving systems to millions of customers.

• End‑to‑End Ownership: You will own the strategy, framework, and evidence assessment for AV behavior and AI safety.

• Cross‑Functional Reach: You will collaborate across AI, software, validation, simulation, metrics operations and vehicle program teams, shaping the direction of GM’s automated driving roadmap.

What You’ll Do (Responsibilities):

• Own AI and AV behavior safety strategy for next generation ADS architectures

• Design and implement AI Safety strategies for cutting-edge AI Models like Imitation Learning and Reinforcement learning.

• Own the behavior‑focused portion of the ADS Safety Case, including key claims, sufficiency criteria, and recommended evidence for AV behavior safety performance.

• Collaborate with Software Validation, Embodied AI, Simulation, and Safety Metrics teams to define the end‑to‑end AV behavior validation and AI safety methodology for AI‑driven systems.

• Collaborate on evaluation metrics, human benchmarks, and safety launch targets for AV behaviors, AI Safety, and overall system performance.

• Innovate and co-develop safety performance indicators (SPIs) for AV behaviors.

• Innovate and co-develop metrics for all stages of ML model development lifecycle

• Reference and interpret standards such as ISO/PAS 8800 (AI Safety), ISO 21448 (SOTIF), ISO 5083, and AVSC best practices to define GM’s strategy for safe autonomous system development, validation and deployment

• Assess AV performance across safety and reliability dimensions using simulation, closed‑course, and public‑road data and provide clear, prioritized feedback

title: Director of Data Architecture
description:
Supplier.io is the data foundation that enterprises build their supplier decisions on. Fragmented, duplicated, and unreliable supplier data quietly limits the ROI of source-to-pay platforms, analytics, risk, and AI initiatives, so we resolve, enrich, and continuously maintain the industry's most complete supplier identity, then put it to work for the teams that buy and the suppliers themselves. Relied on by companies across the Fortune 2000 for accurate data, our platform helps corporate procurement, finance, and compliance teams manage their vendor master, source diverse and sustainable suppliers, and mitigate risk, all from one verified identity instead of a dozen disconnected systems.

Our solutions turn that foundation into action: accurate data and continuous maintenance for teams managing a fragmented vendor master, sourcing intelligence built resolving even the hardest-to-identify suppliers, small, local, and diverse businesses, for teams tracking sustainability and compliance, and direct visibility for the suppliers themselves into where they stand with the enterprises that buy from them. Whether you're resolving vendor records, sourcing alternatives, or measuring program results, Supplier.io transforms complexity into clarity, so teams can lead with confidence and build supply chains that deliver for both business and community.

For more information, visit .

The Opportunity

The Director, Data Architecture owns the strategy, standards, and team behind how data moves through Supplier.io , from source systems and web-scraping pipelines through ingestion, transformation, and governed delivery into the warehouses and marts the rest of the business relies on. You'll operate as a peer to our other engineering leaders, setting data architecture direction jointly with the CTO, while staying accountable for the reliability, quality, and governance of every data workflow we run.

You'll lead two distinct groups: a Data Engineering team building new pipelines, models, and architecture, and a Data Operations Engineering team running and maintaining the processes already in production. In the near term, before the team and its processes are fully built out, this role is hands-on: you'll be designing pipelines, data models, and orchestration directly, not just directing from a distance.

What You Will Do

Data Architecture & Platform Strategy

• Own the multi-year data architecture strategy across our data warehouses and operational data stores, including evolving toward a medallion (bronze, silver, gold) lakehouse model.

• Design and own our data lake and warehouse architecture, including the formation and population of data marts that serve analytics, product, and stakeholder reporting needs.

• Set the orchestration strategy and standards for all data workflows, including source ingestion, web-scraping pipelines, ETL/ELT, and automated workflow management, and standardize the tooling used across the function.

• Own the infrastructure and administration behind our data warehouses and pipelines, including capacity, reliability, and cost.

• Own data governance end to end: the policies, standards, and practices for data quality, lineage, access, retention, and classification across every system of record.

Team & Execution Leadership

• Build, lead, and grow two functions: Data Engineering, building new pipelines, models, and architecture, and Data Operations Engineering, running and maintaining existing production data processes.

• Decide how the function is organized as it scales, including when and whether to add management layers beneath you to run day-to-day execution.

• Stay hands-on early: design and review pipelines, data models, and orchestration directly until the team is built out to carry that execution independently, and stay close enough to the technology afterward to make credible architecture calls.

Cross-Functional Partnership

• Partner with engineering leadership to keep data architecture decisions aligned

We embrace these ebbs and flows because they create space for both intense, focused work and time for learning, reflection, and personal growth. This is part of our philosophy that work and life shouldn't be at odds - they should be integrated in a sustainable and energizing way.
At our core, we're built on a simple belief: when our team members flourish, our clients flourish, and ultimately, communities thrive. That's why we've created an environment that supports your growth, values your expertise, and understands that the best solutions come from people who feel empowered and energized by their work.
